# Appendix A. Complete Message Schemas

The following protobuf definitions are normative. The package name for all schemas is ocps.v2.

## A.1 Common

```protobuf
syntax = "proto3";
package ocps.v2;

message OcpsHeader {
  uint32 version      = 1;  // MUST be 2
  uint64 timestamp_ms = 2;
  bytes  cert_id      = 3;  // 8 bytes
  uint32 msg_class    = 4;
  uint32 seq          = 5;
  uint32 horizon_m    = 6;
  uint32 lifetime_ms  = 7;
}

message Pose {
  double lat           = 1;  // WGS-84, degrees
  double lon           = 2;  // WGS-84, degrees
  float  alt_m         = 3;
  float  yaw_deg       = 4;  // clockwise from true north
  float  pitch_deg     = 5;
  float  roll_deg      = 6;
  float  speed_mps     = 7;
  float  accel_mps2    = 8;  // longitudinal, signed
}

message Dimensions {
  uint32 length_cm = 1;
  uint32 width_cm  = 2;
  uint32 height_cm = 3;
}
```

## A.2 PerceptionSummary

```protobuf
message PerceivedObject {
  uint32 class_id       = 1;  // see §7.2
  uint32 confidence     = 2;  // 0-255, see §7.3
  float  range_m        = 3;
  float  bearing_deg    = 4;  // relative to transmitter heading
  Dimensions dims       = 5;
  float  rel_v_long_mps = 6;
  float  rel_v_lat_mps  = 7;
  uint32 sensor_mask    = 8;  // bit0=radar, bit1=lidar,
                              // bit2=camera, bit3=ultrasonic,
                              // bit4=other
  bytes  vendor_oid     = 9;  // optional; empty unless class_id=0xFF
}

message PerceptionSummary {
  OcpsHeader header     = 1;
  Pose       own_pose   = 2;
  Dimensions own_dims   = 3;
  repeated PerceivedObject objects = 4;
  bytes signature       = 15; // ECDSA-P256 over fields 1-4
}
```

## A.3 Intent

```protobuf
enum IntentCode {
  INTENT_UNKNOWN       = 0;
  STRAIGHT             = 1;
  LANE_CHANGE_LEFT     = 2;
  LANE_CHANGE_RIGHT    = 3;
  TURN_LEFT            = 4;
  TURN_RIGHT           = 5;
  MERGE                = 6;
  EXIT                 = 7;
  STOP                 = 8;
  YIELD                = 9;
  PLATOON_FORM         = 10;
  PLATOON_LEAVE        = 11;
}

message Intent {
  OcpsHeader header         = 1;
  IntentCode code           = 2;
  uint32     prediction_ms  = 3;
  uint32     confidence     = 4;   // 0-255
  bool       driver_committed = 5;
  bytes      group_id       = 6;   // optional, 16 bytes
  bytes      signature      = 15;
}
```

## A.4 GroupState

```protobuf
enum GroupMode {
  GROUP_MODE_UNKNOWN = 0;
  FORMING            = 1;
  STABLE             = 2;
  HANDOFF            = 3;
  DISSOLVING         = 4;
}

message GroupState {
  OcpsHeader header      = 1;
  bytes      group_id    = 2;  // 16 bytes
  repeated bytes members = 3;  // ordered; each 8 bytes (cert_id)
  bytes      leader      = 4;  // 8 bytes
  GroupMode  mode        = 5;
  float      gap_target_s = 6;
  float      speed_setpoint_mps = 7;
  uint64     epoch       = 8;
  bytes      signature   = 15;
}
```

## A.5 Attestation

```protobuf
message SensorHealth {
  uint32 radar_active      = 1;
  uint32 radar_degraded    = 2;
  uint32 lidar_active      = 3;
  uint32 lidar_degraded    = 4;
  uint32 camera_active     = 5;
  uint32 camera_degraded   = 6;
  uint32 ultrasonic_active = 7;
  uint32 ultrasonic_degraded = 8;
}

message Attestation {
  OcpsHeader   header          = 1;
  string       vendor_oid      = 2;
  string       stack_version   = 3;
  bytes        build_fingerprint  = 4;  // SHA-256
  bytes        config_fingerprint = 5;  // SHA-256
  bytes        platform_quote  = 6;     // HSM/TPM attestation blob
  SensorHealth sensors         = 7;
  bytes        signature       = 15;
}
```

## A.6 Telemetry

```protobuf
enum TelemetryKind {
  TELEMETRY_UNKNOWN     = 0;
  ROAD_SURFACE_FRICTION = 1;
  WEATHER_ESTIMATE      = 2;
  LOCAL_CONGESTION      = 3;
  HAZARD_FLAG           = 4;
}

message Telemetry {
  OcpsHeader    header = 1;
  TelemetryKind kind   = 2;
  bytes         payload = 3;   // kind-specific encoding
  bytes         signature = 15;
}
```
